definition: In semantics and text extraction, name resolution refers to the ability of text mining software to determine which actual person, actor, or object a particular use of a name refers to.
details: It can also be referred to as entity resolution.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. Think of it this way: In semantics and text extraction, name resolution refers to the ability of text mining software to determine which actual person, actor, or object a particular use of a name refers to. And here is the clever part: It can also be referred to as entity resolution. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. And that is Name resolution (semantics and text extraction) — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
